description: The narrowest set the application runs on: one line per command, no plugin `default` sets. A `default` set is every command a plugin exposes, not the minimum it needs — `core:window:default` alone is 28, of which this application calls one. See ADR-0013 for why each line below is here, and ADR-0012 for why minimise, maximise and close are not: those act through a command of ours, so the webview never holds a grant over the window. A capability is a permanent grant to code that renders hostile input, so widening this is a Phase 2 proposal with an ADR (CLAUDE.md 7.6). Issue #39.
